translations.app.name: Palworld
translations.app.subtitle: Server Manager
translations.settings.title: Settings
translations.settings.subtitle: Desktop behavior and manager-owned storage.
translations.settings.tray.title: Close to system tray
translations.settings.tray.description: Keep the manager and supervised servers operating when the window is closed. Quit fully from the tray menu.
translations.settings.tray.enabledNotice: Closing the window will keep the manager in the tray.
translations.settings.tray.disabledNotice: Closing the window will exit the manager.
translations.settings.launch.title: Launch at login
translations.settings.launch.description: Start the manager after signing in so worlds with autostart enabled can recover without manually opening the application.
translations.settings.launch.hiddenHelp: Adds --hidden only to the login launch.
translations.settings.launch.gpuHelp: Adds --disable-gpu as a renderer compatibility fallback.
translations.settings.launch.x11Help: Adds --ozone-platform=x11 for remote-desktop or Wayland issues.
translations.settings.launch.flagsHelp: Advanced Electron/Chromium flags, separated by spaces. Quotes are supported. Manager-controlled and remote-debugging flags are rejected.
translations.settings.launch.compatibilityHelp: Linux AppImage shared-memory and sandbox compatibility flags remain automatic. These options affect login launches only; manual launches are unchanged.
translations.settings.launch.enabledHiddenNotice: The manager will start hidden in the tray at login.
translations.settings.launch.enabledWindowNotice: The manager will start with its window open at login.
translations.settings.launch.savedEnabledNotice: Login launch options saved and the autostart entry was updated.
translations.settings.launch.savedDisabledNotice: Login launch options saved. They will be used if launch at login is enabled.
translations.settings.port.title: Manager web port
translations.settings.port.description: The desktop interface and authenticated remote screen share this port. Changing it requires a manager restart.
translations.settings.port.label: Port
translations.settings.port.savedRestart: Manager port {{port}} saved. Restart the manager to apply it.
translations.settings.retention.title: History and log retention
translations.settings.retention.description: Keep useful operational records without allowing the manager database and per-launch server logs to grow forever. The age and count limits are both enforced; whichever is reached first applies. Running operations are never removed.
translations.settings.retention.help: Saving applies cleanup immediately. Future cleanup runs automatically every six hours.
translations.settings.retention.removedNotice: Retention policy saved. Cleanup removed {{count}} expired record or log file.
translations.settings.retention.removedNotice_other: Retention policy saved. Cleanup removed {{count}} expired records or log files.
translations.settings.retention.emptyNotice: Retention policy saved. Nothing currently needs cleanup.
translations.settings.data.title: Manager data
translations.settings.data.description: The rewrite keeps its database, SteamCMD, logs, and backups separate from the legacy manager.
translations.settings.language.title: Language
translations.settings.language.description: English is built in. Additional validated PSM Next language packs can be installed without replacing application files.
translations.settings.language.label: Display language
translations.settings.language.fileHelp: Language packs are JSON files. Missing strings fall back to English.
translations.settings.language.removedNotice: Language pack removed; English fallback remains available.
translations.settings.language.invalidSize: Language packs must be smaller than 512 KiB.
